# Nazrul Effendy - UGM Faculty Profile & Resources

> > Academic resource hub for signal processing, control systems, and artificial intelligence courses at Universitas Gadjah Mada, with curated tools and educational materials.

This is the faculty website of Nazrul Effendy at Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) in Yogyakarta, Indonesia. The site serves as a central repository for engineering lectures, technical resources, and academic guidance across signal processing, control systems, AI, and database technologies.

## Key Topics

- Signal Processing
- Control Systems
- Artificial Intelligence
- Signal & System Fistek
- Kontrol Modern
- Kontrol Cerdas
- Sistem Basis Data
- Database Systems
- Universitas Gadjah Mada
- Course Catalog
- Thesis Guidance
- LaTeX Tutorial
- Image Processing
- Technical Writing
- Free Software Tools

## Lectures & Courses

- [Lectures/Courses/Tutorials](https://nazrul.staff.ugm.ac.id/lecture): UGM course catalog with Nazrul's lectures on signal processing, control systems, and AI including Signal & System Fistek, Kontrol Modern, Kontrol Cerdas, and Sistem Basis Data

## Faculty & Research

- [Syifaun Nafisah's Homepage](http://nazrul.staff.ugm.ac.id/syifa_index.html): Faculty profile for Syifaun Nafisah with research interests in artificial intelligence, computer graphics, and information technology

## Tools & Resources

- [Free Software (Freeware)](https://nazrul.staff.ugm.ac.id/freeware): Directory of free software tools including OpenCV for image processing, antivirus solutions, and office productivity suites

## Optional Resources

- [Do you want to know about Islam ?](https://nazrul.staff.ugm.ac.id/islam): Introductory Islamic education resources with Qur'an references and prayer time tools via Athan and Islamic Finder
- [Tokyo International Center (TIC)](https://nazrul.staff.ugm.ac.id/TIC): JICA Tokyo International Center resources and expat information for Indonesia
